C-22.IntentSummary: Move landing rendering into VitePress (buildEnd + dev middleware), parametrize base/URL, add shared SEO head + sitemap/robots/CNAME + opt-in analytics, add a dist checker, and collapse deployment to one GitHub Pages workflow.

T-001.Title: Landing renderer + config (base, head, sitemap, dev middleware, buildEnd, analytics hook)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: renderLanding(template, opts) substitutes %BASE% and injects the shared head; config.mts uses it in dev (middleware at base root) and in buildEnd (writes dist/index.html, robots.txt, CNAME).
check-dist.mjs walks every dist HTML, resolves internal href/src against dist (cleanUrls aware), fails on misses, leftover %BASE%, missing sitemap/robots.

Verification.Command: cd site && npm run build && npm run check && SITE_BASE=/mark/ npm run build && SITE_BASE=/mark/ npm run check

T-003.Title: Pipeline: single GitHub Pages workflow, PR build-only, vercel.json removed

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: site.yml: build+check on PR and main; deploy only on main/dispatch; SITE_URL/SITE_BASE/UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID from repo vars with domain defaults.
